SNSKTLNG 1: Full class in the script, grammar, and vocabulary of the Sanskrit language of ancient India. Also included will be some readings from the Bhagavad Gita. No previous knowledge of Sanskrit required.
SNSKTLNG 3: Continuation of SNSKTLNG 2. Prerequisite: SNSKTLNG 2. The completion of this course fulfills the University Language Requirement
SNSKTLNG 395: Prerequisite: For Grad Students Only and Consent of Instructor
